items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Whether or not you’re going to start playing a Celine Dion tune from The Titanic, at least you should know it exists.

ctx.x: That’s very kind-hearted of you to say that.

The only way I would do it is if I got sick or . . . Once in a while I do think of who could do it. You’d be a likely candidate. You’re a good interviewer, and you’re not afraid. You’re industrious. You’re not . . . You know so much. You do a lot of research. You know . . . I think a lot of musicians are not interested in other musicians. I remember when I had Teddy on the show, I was surprised at people that were coming up. This is a long time ago, and I can’t remember who I spoke to him about. The people who…
